# agentic-design

Accessible design tokens and UI primitives for calm, minimal apps.

Keywords: design-system,tokens,ui,accessibility,wcag,react,components,minimal,dark-mode.

- CSS: import "agentic-design/styles.css", then use var(--agd-color-bg) and friends.
- Library: import { themes, scale } from "agentic-design/tokens". React parts: import { Button, ShareDialog, PresenceChip } from "agentic-design/react".
- App chrome (React): AppShell (title slot, side panel with panelLabel), DocumentTitle (renames in place), AgentBadge (marks an agent with "Made by an agent" by default, a square avatar, and who it acts for; a custom label should say an agent made the item), Toolbar with ToolbarGroup and ToolbarOverflow.
- Files (React): FileList with items gives a sortable table or grid (view "table" or "grid", sort by name, owner, or modified); FileRow children give a plain list.
- CLI: agentic-design tokens --format json.
- MCP: run agentic-design mcp, then call get_tokens or check_contrast.
- HTTP: GET /api/v1/tokens.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-design
- License: MIT

- ItemHeader: shared item chrome with backLink, shareButton, fileMenu, presence, and maxPresence slots/props. title and async onRename control inline rename. Enter/blur saves, Escape cancels, blank refused; saving and error states are announced. Omit onRename for read-only.
